description: Get hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices for a Nordic/European bidding zone (e.g. "DK1", "DK2", or connected zones like "DE", "NO2", "SE3"). Returns each hour's price in both DKK/MWh and EUR/MWh. Supports an optional date range (start_date/end_date); omit both to get the most recent hours. Data: Energinet (Danish TSO), no auth required.

end_date.description: End of the time range, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-09-02"). Omit for the most recent data.

limit.description: Maximum number of hourly price points to return (1-200, default 24)

price_area.description: Bidding/price zone to filter by, e.g. "DK1" (West Denmark), "DK2" (East Denmark), or a connected zone such as "DE", "NO2", "SE3". Omit to return all zones.

start_date.description: Start of the time range, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-09-01" or "2026-09-01T00:00"). Omit for the most recent data.

name: denmark-energidataservice.power.spot_prices

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Denmark Electricity Spot Prices
